### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick (epic-588e completion-verifier advisory)

#### Expected Behavior
compute-diff-hash.sh documents that the degraded hardcoded fallback (used only when review-gate-allowlist.conf is unreadable) MUST match the 3783-tightened normal allowlist — i.e. docs/** must be reviewable (not allowlisted) even on the degraded path.

#### Actual Behavior
skip-review-check.sh (~line 68) still lists docs/* in its graceful-degradation hardcoded fallback. The NORMAL path (tightened conf) is correct and the docs/workflows/* force-review override (~line 135) supersedes it, so SC5 holds — but the degraded fallback is a latent inconsistency vs 3783's invariant. Low priority; only reachable when the conf file is unreadable.
data.title: [skip-review-check]: graceful-degradation fallback (line ~68) retains docs/* -> diverges from 3783-tightened allowlist when conf unreadable
